chunks: And as for the right of your stomach, it is that you do not make it a container for the unlawful and you do not exceed satiety.
ai.seo_question: What are the rights of the stomach according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin frames the stomach not merely as a biological organ but as a vessel for spiritual nourishment, warning that consuming haram sustains the body while overeating dulls the intellect and heart. This teaching aligns with the Shia tradition of 'moderation' (wasatiyyah), where physical discipline is directly linked to the clarity of worship and the purification of the soul.
